# contemplative-agent-otel

> Offline converter from contemplative-agent's replayable audit JSONL logs (ADR-0075) to OpenTelemetry OTLP traces with GenAI semantic conventions (Development status). Zero runtime coupling: reads log files only, never instruments or imports the main repository, which keeps its requests+numpy dependency floor.

Key facts:
- The main repository rejected runtime OpenTelemetry (ADR-0075): single local process, minimal dependencies, research-grade offline replay as the primary observability requirement.
- This sibling connects the existing logs to the OTel ecosystem after the fact: JSONL → OTLP/HTTP (:4318) or OTLP/JSON file.
- Untrusted content (CAPTCHA challenge bodies, server response bodies) is dropped at parse time; only hashes and categorical error classes reach span attributes. Enforced by a regression test.
- Traces are grouped into agent run root spans by the logs' run_id (stamped since 2026-07-16), with time-gap clustering as the fallback for older records; ca.convert.grouping on the root span says which was used.
- LLM calls map to gen_ai.* attributes (operation text_completion, provider ollama); API calls to http.* / url.template; duration-less records become zero-width spans.
- Known limitation: embedding rows (caller="embed") in llm-calls-*.jsonl are read as text_completion spans, without their batch_size / input_chars / rows fields; ca.audit.caller and the embedding model in the span name and gen_ai.request.model tell them apart.
- Status: maintained by hand by one author, separately from the main repository; not on PyPI (installed from source); not yet in the author's routine use.
